title: How names are matched
text: fuzzy_method chooses edits counted: "dl" (Damerau-Levenshtein, default) counts insertion, deletion, substitution swap two neighbouring letters one edit . "levenshtein" counts swap two edits, deletion insertion. "jw" (Jaro-Winkler) gives similarity 0 1 weights agreement start name; distance one minus similarity. names method: Levenshtein distance twice Damerau-Levenshtein distance names swapped letters (Qurecus, officianle, repnes, Betual) others. Jaro-Winkler distances smaller throughout, shared genus start name raises similarity, threshold set "dl" much looser "jw".
code: dist_of <- function(method) {   r <- taxify(messy, backbone = "wfo", fuzzy_method = method,               verbose = FALSE)   round(r$fuzzy_dist, 3) } data.frame(   input = messy,   dl = dist_of("dl"),   levenshtein = dist_of("levenshtein"),   jw = dist_of("jw") ) #>                  input    dl levenshtein    jw #> 1        Qurecus robur 0.077       0.154 0.021 #> 2 Taraxacum officianle 0.050       0.100 0.010 #> 3 Plantago lanceoalata 0.050       0.050 0.031 #> 4     Trifolium repnes 0.062       0.125 0.013 #> 5       Lolium perrene 0.143       0.143 0.029 #> 6  Achillea millefolum 0.050       0.050 0.010 #> 7       Betual pendula 0.071       0.143 0.014 #> 8     Ranunculus acris    NA          NA    NA

title: How names are matched
text: fuzzy_threshold = 0.2, default, accepts distance 0.2: one edit 5-letter name, two 12-letter name, four 20-letter name. lower value stricter: Poa trialis needs two edits 13 characters become Poa trivialis, distance 0.154, default threshold accepts 0.15 rejects. whole number caps edits , whatever length name. fuzzy_threshold = 1 accepts one edit, fits data whose errors known single letters, optical character recognition (OCR) process drops doubles character: Jaro-Winkler counts edits, takes fractional threshold.

code: all_names <- c(checked, "Fraxinus excelsior", "Tilia cordata",                "Sorbus aucuparia") parts <- split(all_names, ceiling(seq_along(all_names) / 3)) out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "taxify-parts") dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {   file <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("part_%04d.rds", i))   if (file.exists(file)) next   res <- taxify(parts[[i]], backbone = "wfo", verbose = FALSE)   saveRDS(res, file) }  files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE) matched <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, readRDS)) nrow(matched) #> [1] 9

title: Match taxonomic names against local backbone databases — taxify
text: x Character vector taxonomic names. backbone Character vector backbone names (e.g., "wfo", "col", "gbif") single taxify_backend object. Several tried order fallback chain. NULL (default) uses every installed backbone priority order, installing default set (COL, GBIF, ITIS) first use; override priority options(taxify.backbone_priority = ...) first-run set options(taxify.default_backbones = ...). fuzzy Logical. Enable fuzzy matching names fail exact match. Default TRUE. fuzzy_threshold Numeric. Maximum allowed distance fuzzy matches. Two modes depending value: Fractional (0 < fuzzy_threshold < 1): normalized distance (edits / max name length). Default 0.2 1 edit per 5 characters. Integer (fuzzy_threshold >= 1): maximum raw edit count, e.g. fuzzy_threshold = 2L allows 2 insertions/deletions/substitutions regardless name length. supported fuzzy_method = "jw". fuzzy_method Character. One "dl" (Damerau-Levenshtein, default), "levenshtein", "jw" (Jaro-Winkler). aggregates Character. treat species aggregates (names agg. / s.l. qualifier). "preserve" (default) keeps aggregate concept: matches backbone's aggregate taxon ("<binomial> aggr.") one exists, otherwise falls back binomial. output's aggregate_fallback column records happened aggregate: TRUE fell back binomial, FALSE resolved dedicated aggregate taxon. Euro+Med WoRMS carry aggregate taxa, preserve falls back backbones. "collapse" strips marker matches binomial species, way non-aggregate name matched. Either way qualifier recorded qualifier column. region Region(s) constrain fuzzy matching , NULL (default) geographic constraint. Botanical (WCVP, vascular plants): TDWG Level 3 codes ("BGM", c("BGM", "GER")) region names level, matched case- accent-insensitively bundled WGSRPD crosswalk: Level 3 name ("Belgium"), Level 2 region ("Middle Europe"), Level 1 continent ("Europe", expands codes). Marine (marine_distribution asset installed): MEOW ecoregion ECO_CODE, ecoregion / province / realm name (province realm expands member ecoregions). See taxify_regions() lists. set, fuzzy candidates restricted species range records region(s); exact matches always kept. filter narrows genuinely ambiguous fuzzy candidates: candidate dropped input name another candidate -region range data, match group range coverage never affected name whose candidate --region still returned. coords Coordinates constrain fuzzy matching , mapped region codes point--polygon unioned region. Points tested WGSRPD botanical boundaries (yielding TDWG codes) , marine asset installed, MEOW ecoregion boundaries (yielding ECO_CODEs), coastal point can resolve . single c(lon, lat) pair, matrix/data.frame longitude/latitude columns (named lon/lat x/y, else first two columns lon, lat), point-geometry spatial object (sf/sfc object terra SpatVector, reprojected longitude/latitude automatically). NULL (default) none. boundary file downloaded cached; coordinate lookup needs download (prior cache). point-- polygon test uses terra sf installed, otherwise native fallback; force engine options(taxify.pip_engine = "terra" | "sf" | "native"). range Character. range statuses count -region region coords set. "present" (default) accepts record (native, introduced, extinct, unknown status), right choice name disambiguation. "native" accepts native records, "introduced" introduced (alien) records; fold ecological filter matching callers want . Ignored region set. kingdom Character. Restrict matches one kingdoms, disambiguate name shared across kingdoms (Prunella bird plant, Oenanthe ). NULL (default) applies constraint. Accepts kingdom name common alias, case-insensitively: "animals"/"Animalia"/"Metazoa", "plants"/"Plantae", "fungi", "bacteria", "archaea", "chromista", "protozoa", "viruses". matched taxon kept kingdom requested one (unknown, never rejected); default multi-backbone fallback, name backbone resolves wrong kingdom passed next backbone, -kingdom treatment wins. kingdom read backbone stores one (COL, ITIS, NCBI, OTT, WoRMS); backbone (WFO, GBIF), falls back genus register's kingdom, split genus homonymous across kingdoms; name kingdom-appropriate backbone . mode Character. combine results backbone names one backbone. "fallback" (default) fallback chain described : one answer per name, first backbone matched. "wide" "agreement" instead consult every backbone every name report compare, backbone disagreement (see Backbone-specific accepted names section) visible one call rather querying backbone hand. return strict superset "fallback" result (standard columns, accepted_name still fallback pick, frame still pipes add_*() enrichments) plus: "wide": one accepted_<backbone> column per backbone logical all_agree. "agreement": n_backbones_matched, n_distinct_accepted, all_agree. all_agree TRUE/FALSE least two backbones matched name NA fewer two (nothing compare). Ignored (message) one backbone given, since nothing compare. verbose Logical. Print progress messages. Default TRUE.

NA nothing matched. is_hybrid Logical. hybrid marker detected input? hybrid_type "nothogenus" ("x Cupressocyparis leylandii"), "nothospecies" ("Quercus x hispanica"), "formula" ("Salix alba x Salix fragilis"), NA non-hybrid. Nothogenus nothospecies resolve single backbone taxon usual columns. formula resolves way backbone stores cross; otherwise match_type "hybrid_formula", ID, rank classification columns NA, matched_name / accepted_name name cross parents parents resolve. parent binomials, accepted names, added demand add_hybrid_info(). qualifier Canonical taxonomic qualifier found input name ("cf.", "aff.", "agg.", "s.l.", "s.str.", "sp.", ...), NA. Spelling variants folded one token ("aggr.", "agg" "sensu lato" map "agg."/"s.l."). qualifier_position "genus" qualifier leads name qualifies whole name (e.g. "Cf. Pinus sylvestris"), "species" qualifies species (inline cf. trailing agg.), NA qualifier. aggregate_fallback Logical. aggregate query aggregates = "preserve": FALSE resolved backbone's dedicated aggregate taxon, TRUE taxon existed fell back nominal binomial. NA non-aggregate queries aggregates = "collapse", collapse explicit. match_type One "exact", "exact_ci", "fuzzy", "abbrev" (abbreviated genus "Q. robur" resolved via genus initial plus epithet), "hybrid_formula" (two-parent cross backbone store; ID, rank classification columns NA, matched_name / accepted_name name cross parents resolve, add_hybrid_info() materializes parents hybrid_parent_* columns), "rank_fallback" (infraspecific name backbone carries, resolved species: ID, rank name columns describe species), "basionym" (record backbone keeps unplaced, resolved taxon places record's basionym: matched_name, taxon_id taxonomic_status describe unplaced record, accepted_* columns taxon; needs backbone built basionym links), "none". fuzzy_dist Normalized string distance (0–1), NA exact. n_ids Integer. many distinct accepted taxa backbone files matched name , across every record (accepted, doubtful, unplaced, synonym). 1 name one accepted ID; homonym name backbone holds twice, e.g. GBIF's Karwinskia mollis, kept accepted Schltdl. name doubtful Standl. one. NA nothing matched. accepted_ids Character. accepted IDs, |-joined, one accepted_id first (accepted_id name one). columns every result; printing leaves row one ID. List names, status GBIF occurrence counts taxify_ids(). backbone backbone used (e.g., "wfo", "col", "gbif"). backbone_version Backend name, version, download date (e.g., "wfo:2024-12 (2026-04-01)"). Useful reproducibility. kingdom_group Coarse kingdom-level group matched genus, bundled genus register (used cross-kingdom disambiguation); NA genus register. taxon_group Broad taxonomic group matched genus, genus register; NA unavailable. life_form Life-form classification matched genus, genus register's family-based lookup; NA unavailable.

title: taxify 0.3.3
text: WCVP LCVP join plant backbones. taxify(x, backend = "wcvp") matches Kew’s World Checklist Vascular Plants (Govaerts et al. 2021, ~1.4M names, CC 4.0); backend = "lcvp" matches Leipzig Catalogue Vascular Plants (Freiberg et al. 2020, MIT). slot fallback chain (backend = c("wcvp", "wfo")) contribute genera (kingdom Plantae) unified genus register. Fifteen backbones now available. Four new verbs read backbone directions taxify() . synonyms() lists every synonym resolves name’s accepted taxon (reverse forward resolution). add_classification() fills higher ranks (kingdom, phylum, class, order) matched backbone, complementing family genus already core output. children() lists accepted taxa within genus family, building checklist rather validating one. taxify_candidates() expands ambiguous match (is_ambiguous) one row per candidate accepted taxon, homonyms can resolved hand. taxify() gains aggregate_fallback column makes default aggregates = "preserve" accountable. backbone carries dedicated aggregate taxon aggregate query, preserve falls back nominal binomial; collapse now flagged (TRUE fallback, FALSE aggregate taxon matched, NA non-aggregate queries collapse) rather silent. Euro+Med (433 aggregate taxa) WoRMS (189) carry , preserve -op backbones – flag now says per row. add_kew_sid() opens Kew Seed Information Database (SER-SID, CC 2.0): seed weight (thousand-seed weight 42,000 species), storage behaviour (orthodox/recalcitrant/intermediate), oil protein content, life form, fruit type, joined accepted_name across 50,146 accepted names. Verified end--end (Quercus robur 3493 g/1000 seeds recalcitrant; Helianthus annuus 43.5% seed oil). seed weight also joins cross-source add_trait("seed_mass") verb seventh source (thousand-seed weight grams equals per-seed mass mg; grounded ratio 1.00 Diaz, BIEN, AusTraits), roughly doubling seed-mass species coverage. add_edwards_phyto() opens Edwards et al. (2015) phytoplankton nutrient-utilization database (~130 species): Droop/Monod uptake growth parameters ammonium, nitrate, phosphorus (mu/k/vmax/qmin/qmax), plus cell volume, carbon content, taxonomic group, marine/freshwater habitat. curated core attaches default; cols = "" surfaces every uptake parameter. Door-(single-source physiology cross-source analogue), stays add_trait() verb. Verified end--end (Alexandrium catenella recovered marine dinoflagellate). Nine new add_trait() traits covering algae, marine-benthic invertebrates, octocorals, grounded source’s vocabulary wiring. Algae (AlgaeTraits): calcification, gamete_type, algal_life_cycle (dominant ploidy phase), algal_substrate. Marine benthos, harmonized across two sources (Arctic Traits + New Zealand Trait Database): bioturbation (Solan/Queiros functional groups), living_habit, feeding_guild. Octocoral (Gomez-Gras et al. 2024): skeletal_rigidity, colony_growth_form. Verified end--end (Corallina calcified-articulated, Fucus diplontic, Laminaria haplodiplontic; bryozoan Alcyonidium gelatinosum attached suspension-feeder bioturbation). sporulation (endospore formation, source), extending prokaryote block; larval_nutrition (bee larval food, EuPollTrait); colour_lightness (beetle body greyness 0-255, saproxylic beetle traits, melanism axis); cell_surface_area (microalgae, um2, Rimet et al., alongside cell_length/cell_width/cell_thickness/cell_biovolume); carapace_length (turtle, mm, TurtleTraits); parental_care (fish Balon reproductive guild guarder/non-guarder/bearer, Beukhof et al. 2019). Verified end--end (Thermus aquaticus GC 67%, Bacillus subtilis sporulates, leatherback carapace 2.26 m, stickleback guarder). add_trait("fruit_type") also gains AusTraits third plant source. Three new add_trait() traits, grounded source’s values wiring: zooxanthellate (coral symbiotic state, Coral Trait Database octocoral dataset, share zooxanthellate/azooxanthellate vocabulary), optimal_growth_ph (prokaryote, Madin et al. 2020, pH companion optimal_growth_temperature), cell_thickness (microalgae, Rimet et al., alongside existing cell_length/cell_width/cell_biovolume). add_trait("diet_guild") now also draws EltonTraits (Wilman et al. 2014), extending diet guilds birds reptiles mammals. guild derived ten EltonTraits diet fractions (built elton_traits.vtr) agrees 93% EltonTraits’ diet classification 83% AVONET. add_elton_traits() exposes diet_guild column directly. add_trait("ellenberg_salt") gains Baseflor third source: salinity column 0-9 Ellenberg scale FloraWeb Ecoflora (Pearson r = 0.88 shared species), joins without rescaling. New add_trait() traits egg_length egg_width (mm) gather reptile, bird, turtle egg dimensions Amniote database, ReptTraits, TurtleTraits, agree within measurement noise shared species. New add_trait("brain_mass") (g) coalesces COMBINE AnimalTraits (kg converted grams), calibrated 1:1 shared species. Wider taxonomic coverage several life-history traits, source shared-species calibrated added: reproductive_frequency now spans mammals reptiles turtles (AnAge, PanTHERIA, ReptTraits, TurtleTraits added); clutch_litter_size gains turtles (TurtleTraits) birds (Birdbase); age_at_maturity gains turtles fish (TurtleTraits, Beukhof); longevity gains fish (Beukhof, whose ~390 yr maximum Greenland shark). add_trait("pollination_vector") gains FloraWeb AusTraits, agree 82-91% existing Baseflor Ecoflora sources shared species. Named insect taxa (bee, beetle, fly, …) resolve insect; AusTraits’ coarse biotic/abiotic animal (bird, bat) records single vector vocabulary stay NA rather guessed. Six new add_trait() traits, numeric source shared-species calibrated (ratio ~1.00) co-registered source added: male_maturity (yr; AnAge, Amniote, COMBINE – male analogue age_at_maturity), incubation_period (days; Amniote, TurtleTraits egg incubation, kept separate combined gestation_incubation), diet_breadth (count dietary categories; COMBINE, PanTHERIA, Birdbase), tongue_length (mm; Ostwald, EuPollTrait bee proboscis), aspect_ratio (caudal-fin aspect ratio; Beukhof, Quimbayo), foraging_mode (active/ambush/mixed; ReptTraits, TurtleTraits). add_trait("diet_guild") gains TurtleTraits Blanchard ant diets, mapped guild vocabulary ordered regex (compound “omnivorous carnivorous” resolves primary guild; ant “predator” carnivore). Six add_trait() traits: reproductive_mode (oviparous/ovoviviparous/ viviparous; ReptTraits plus Sharkipedia, whose shark strategies collapse viviparous); coral-habitat traits coloniality, wave_exposure, water_clarity (Coral Trait DB octocoral, sharing one vocabulary); head_length/head_width (mm; amphibian beetle morphometrics). depth traits depth_min/depth_max gain coral occurrence-depth limits (Coral Trait DB, octocoral) metres unit fish sources. Eleven add_trait() traits, including new prokaryote domain Madin et al. (2020): gram_stain, oxygen_metabolism, cell_shape, optimal_growth_temperature (deg C), genome_size (bp). Also caudal_fin_shape (Beukhof + Quimbayo fish fin shape), voltinism (generations per year; Arthropod Traits + EuPollTrait), migration (AVONET), flightless (BIRDBASE), venomous (ReptTraits), sociality (EuPollTrait bees). thermal_max gains Pottier amphibian CTmax degrees-C scale. Nine add_trait() traits: wingspan (mm; LepTraits butterflies, whose source column labelled mm actually cm, corrected known wingspans monarch, cabbage white, swallowtail); leaf_length leaf_width (mm; AusTraits); fungal_trophic_mode (FUNGuild FungalTraits); feeding_mode mouth_position (fish; Beukhof, Quimbayo); air_breathing (FishBase); motility (prokaryote; Madin); lecty (bee pollen host breadth; EuPollTrait).

title: taxify 0.3.2
text: New add_trait() attaches single trait across every source carries , reconciling vocabularies units. add_*() door joins one dataset, add_trait("seed_mass") gathers sources: pulls seed mass Diaz et al. GIFT returns one unit (mg), woodiness Zanne GIFT one vocabulary, likewise plant height SLA. default mode = "coalesce" adds one value per row columns document – seed_mass, seed_mass_unit, seed_mass_sources, seed_mass_n – keeps chained calls tidy; mode = "wide" instead gives one harmonized column per source (seed_mass_diaz, seed_mass_gift) inspect agreement conflict. sources measure trait different methods (example maximum vs fine-root diameter), value blended: complete source reported seed_mass_caution column explains difference. list_traits() lists available traits trait_info() shows trait’s sources, units, harmonization notes, cautions. registry ships dozens traits spanning plant functional root traits, animal body size, life history morphology, diel activity, thermal limits, phenology, indicator values, conservation status, crosswalk grounded source values rather assumed.

title: taxify 0.3.1
text: New reptiledb backend: Reptile Database (Uetz et al.), global taxonomic reference reptiles (snakes, lizards, amphisbaenians, turtles, crocodiles tuatara). carries ~12.6k accepted species plus ~34k synonyms full genus/family classification, filling one vertebrate class backbones cover partially. Use like backbone: taxify(x, backend = "reptiledb"). License: CC-4.0. New add_repttraits() joins species-level reptile traits ReptTraits (Oskyrko et al. 2024) accepted name. Beyond body-size life-history traits, carries per-species distribution signal – biogeographic realm, elevation range mean climate – across reptiles. replaces earlier add_lizard_traits(), drew ReptTraits source mislabelled (covered reptiles, lizards) exposed morphology columns. License: CC-4.0. New inspect() flags probable typos anomalies name list returns anomalous rows, labelled stands , known, name use instead. inspect() match names backbones – taxify()‘s job. character vector runs checks need matching: unknown (genus genus register, union 13 backbones’ genera, backbone recognises – real “probably name”), near_duplicate (near-twin frequent name list, computed list alone, catches typos names backbone contains), outlier_group (name whose kingdom group tiny minority otherwise coherent list – lone animal fungus among plants). also surface match-based anomalies, opt backbones = TRUE (matches every installed backbone, listed report header) match first inspect result – taxify(x) |> inspect() – adds typo (fuzzy-corrected spelling), synonym (outdated name), ambiguous (homonym), case, geographic checks geographic (species WCVP record declared region/coords) out_of_range (region declared, yet species’ range falls outside list’s main TDWG continents; skipped globally spread lists). Rows ordered -notable first carry suggestion; gets tier describing needs, bad : unresolved (usable name), review (name identity uncertain), note (correct, optional cleanup) – anomaly may intended. inspect() read-: never alters input applies correction. Narrow min_tier. list-context labels apply single name, inspect() one name warns. taxify() gains region argument geographically constrained fuzzy matching. Pass TDWG botanical regions restrict fuzzy candidates species WCVP records regions; exact matches always kept. region accepts Level 3 codes (region = "BGM") region names level, matched case- accent-insensitively bundled WGSRPD crosswalk: botanical country ("Belgium"), Level 2 region ("Middle Europe"), Level 1 continent ("Europe", expanded codes). new coords argument takes c(lon, lat) pair matrix/data.frame coordinates maps regions point--polygon WGSRPD Level 3 boundaries (downloaded cached first use); region coords unioned. coords also accepts sf/sfc object terra SpatVector points (reprojected automatically). point-- polygon test uses terra sf installed falls back native implementation otherwise; engine can forced options(taxify.pip_engine = "terra" | "sf" | "native"). filter narrows genuinely ambiguous fuzzy candidates – candidate dropped input name another candidate -region WCVP range data – non-plant matches never affected name whose candidate --region still returned. companion range argument selects WCVP statuses count -region: "present" (default, record), "native", "introduced". New taxify_regions() lists WGSRPD Level 3 botanical regions (codes names) used region add_wcvp(), optional search term. Two new backbone backends: "fishbase" (FishBase, ~36k accepted fish species) "sealifebase" (SeaLifeBase, ~100k accepted non-fish aquatic species). resolve synonyms accepted names carry kingdom / phylum / class / order classification. Use like backbone, e.g. taxify("Gadus morhua", backend = "fishbase"). add_sealifebase() joins SeaLifeBase morphological ecological traits (body length, mass, trophic level, depth range, vulnerability, habitat, commercial importance) taxify() result. non-fish companion add_fishbase(). add_groot() joins species-level root traits Global Root Traits (GRooT) database: root diameter, specific root length, tissue density, N C concentration, root mass fraction, lateral spread, mycorrhizal colonization rooting depth (per-species means 6,154 vascular plant species).

title: taxify 0.3.0
text: add_qualifier_info() removed. taxify() now reports qualifier natively (see New features), separate parsing pass longer needed. Replace taxify(x) |> add_qualifier_info() taxify(x). Note integer qualifier_position (character index) replaced two-value "genus" / "species" placement.

title: taxify 0.3.0
text: Species aggregates now handled distinct concept. taxify() gains aggregates argument, default "preserve": aggregate name ("... agg.", "... s.l.") matches backbone’s aggregate taxon one exists (example Euro+Med WoRMS), otherwise falls back binomial species. aggregates = "collapse" keeps previous behaviour stripping marker matching binomial. taxify() output carries two new columns. qualifier canonical taxonomic qualifier spelling variants folded one token ("aggr.", "agg" "sensu lato" map "agg." / "s.l."). qualifier_position "genus" leading prefix ("Cf. Pinus sylvestris") "species" inline trailing qualifier ("Pinus cf. sylvestris", "Rubus fruticosus agg."). Trait enrichment aggregate-aware.
